// why: The web repo's tests import these two framework-free files (tests/unit/mobile-client.test.ts, tests/e2e/mobile-client.spec.ts). Their transformers read the nearest tsconfig, and the app's one extends expo/tsconfig.base, which only exists once mobile/node_modules is installed. This file keeps them loadable from the root with no Expo install; the app's own tsc still covers them through mobile/tsconfig.json.
